top.line: From Lovable to your own newsroom
top.para: A brief for José Bota and his agent: Lovable apps to GitHub Pages, a domain with his name and a subdomain per app, a newsroom on the same domain, success as two or three links, and a business in agents' reach.

in-short.para: The tools; GitHub and Pages; a domain; a newsroom; two or three links; the business; private versions.

tools.para: Lovable examples that measure an agent's reach; they work, and need a home, so this brief is for him and his agent.

github.line: Step one: from Lovable to GitHub Pages
github.para: Sync to GitHub, check whether it is Vite or TanStack Start, add a build workflow, and send a link at every step.

domain.line: Step two: a domain with his name
domain.para: Bought in Route 53, which sells .com, .io, .site, .ai and .dev but not .pt; a main site and a subdomain per app, verified in GitHub.

newsroom.line: Step three: newsroom on his domain
newsroom.para: The same workflow as this newsroom, from Your own newsroom, with the reader API to copy; one article per app.

done.para: Two or three links from José, apps and articles, which we write about here and amplify from RiskMandate.

business.para: Small tools that show an agent's reach and danger; a business helping companies see and protect it; public demos and private client repositories.

pack.para: A brief for the agent, a Pages workflow, Route 53 records, an app list and newsroom house rules.

limits.para: A brief, nothing done; names are examples; registries change; private Pages costs; my interest.

sources.para: My voice memo of 31 October, the starter pack and Route 53's domain list.
